docstring: Computes intersection of two intervals supporting unbounded endpoints (None).
signature: def intersect_intervals(s1: int | None, e1: int | None, s2: int | None, e2: int | None) -> tuple[int | None, int | None] | None:
ref_test:
def test_intersect():
    assert intersect_intervals(10, 20, 15, 25) == (15, 20)
    assert intersect_intervals(10, 20, 20, 30) is None
    assert intersect_intervals(None, 50, 20, 80) == (20, 50)
    assert intersect_intervals(None, None, 10, None) == (10, None)
    assert intersect_intervals(50, 100, 10, 40) is None
